name: swifttab
description: Fast inline code completion powered by your own API key: Codestral, DeepSeek, Mercury, OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Together, Fireworks, xAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM and any OpenAI-compatible server. No chat, no agents, no account.

swiftTab.enabled.description: Show inline completions as you type.

enumDescriptions: Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry (chat) — set baseUrl to https://RESOURCE.openai.azure.com/openai/v1
Together AI (chat, or FIM with open coder models)
Fireworks AI (chat, or FIM with open coder models)
DeepInfra (chat, or FIM with open coder models)
Alibaba Qwen / DashScope international (chat, or FIM with Qwen-Coder)
llama.cpp server on localhost:8080 via /infill (FIM, no key)
LM Studio on localhost:1234 (FIM or chat, no key)
Any OpenAI-compatible server: vLLM, LiteLLM, SGLang, TGI, gateways (set baseUrl)
swiftTab.provider.description: Which API serves completions. FIM providers (and FIM mode) are faster and more accurate for completion.

swiftTab.model.description: Model ID. Leave empty to use the provider's default. Use the 'Select Model' command to pick from the provider's list.

swiftTab.baseUrl.description: Override the provider base URL. Required for openaiCompatible and azure; use it to point Ollama / llama.cpp / LM Studio at another host.

enumDescriptions: Fill-in-the-middle: code before and after the cursor, fastest and most accurate
Chat: instruction model prompted to act as a completion engine
swiftTab.mode.description: How completions are requested. Ignored if the provider does not support the chosen mode.

enumDescriptions: Guess from the model name; otherwise send a suffix field
Send prompt + suffix and let the server apply the template (DeepSeek, Ollama, llama.cpp)
StarCoder / StarCoder2 / Granite Code <fim_prefix> with repo-level context
swiftTab.fimTemplate.markdownDescription: FIM prompt format for OpenAI-style `/completions` servers. Servers like vLLM, Together and Fireworks reject a `suffix` field, so the raw prompt must be built with the model template.

swiftTab.debounceMs.description: Wait this long after you stop typing before requesting a completion. Typing that matches a request already in flight reuses it, so low values are cheap.

swiftTab.multiline.description: 'auto' completes whole blocks on empty lines and after openers like '{' or ':', and single lines elsewhere.

swiftTab.suggestAfterAccept.description: After you accept a suggestion, immediately request the next one (multi-line when the line is finished).

swiftTab.maxLines.description: Maximum lines in a multi-line completion.

swiftTab.maxPrefixChars.description: Characters of code before the cursor sent as context.

swiftTab.maxSuffixChars.description: Characters of code after the cursor sent as context.

swiftTab.crossFileContext.description: Include the most relevant snippets from other open files (similarity-ranked).

swiftTab.timeoutMs.description: Abort a request that takes longer than this.

swiftTab.disabledLanguages.description: Language IDs where completion is off.

swiftTab.extraBody.markdownDescription: Extra JSON deep-merged into every request body. Examples: Qwen3 / vLLM `{"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": false}}`; Gemini `{"generationConfig": {"thinkingConfig": {"thinkingBudget": 0}}}`; OpenAI reasoning models `{"reasoning_effort": "minimal"}`.

swiftTab.extraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request (e.g. for gateways or proxies). Do not put API keys here; use the Set API Key command.
